'''Punishment''' is a [[hex]] [[spell]] that applies a [[curse]] to all targets in an area, causing them to take increased damage while on [[low life]] and receive the {{stl|Debilitate}} debuff when they land a [[hit]].

==Skill Functions and Interactions==
[[File:Punishment aura screenshot.png|thumb|right|Punishment aura]]
{{status
| name                   = Punishment
| type                   = Debuff
| description            = You are cursed. You will take increased damage while on low life and be debilitated when you hit enemies. Overkill damage from the hit which kills you will be reflected to nearby targets.
}}
* Punishment can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}}, {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Eldritch Blasphemy Support}}.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now causes Cursed Enemies to be Debilitated for +0.00-1.00 Seconds when they Hit, instead of 0-10% increased Effect of Curse.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.20.0|
* Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Enemies to take ('''30-58''')% increased Damage while on Low Life}} (previously 40-78%).
* No longer has {{c|mod|10% of Overkill Damage from Killing Blows on Cursed Enemies is Reflected to other Enemies as Physical Damage}}.
* Quality on the Anomalous Punishment Skill no longer has {{c|mod|Curse has (0-40)% increased Doom gain rate}}. Instead, it now has {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Curse Duration}}.
* Divergent quality no longer provides {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Area of Effect}}. Instead,  it now provides {{c|mod|(0-10)% of Overkill Damage from Killing Blows on Cursed Enemies is Reflected to other Enemies as Physical damage}}.
* The following Skills now have a base duration of 8 seconds at gem level 1 (previously 9), up to 11.8 at gem level 20 (previously 10.9): {{il|Conductivity}}, {{il|Despair}}, {{il|Elemental Weakness}}, {{il|Enfeeble}}, {{il|Flammability}}, {{il|Frostbite}}, Punishment, and {{il|Vulnerability}}.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.17.3|
* The overkill explosion from the Punishment Curse no longer occurs if the curse is owned by the defender or one of their allies.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.14.0|
* Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Enemies to take ('''40-78''')% increased Damage while on Low Life}} (previously 50-88%).
* The definition of Low Life has changed to 50%
}}
{{Version history table row|3.12.0|
''All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.''
* No longer causes cursed enemies to grant more melee physical damage on melee hit.
* No longer causes cursed enemies to grant increased attack speed on melee hit.
* No longer causes enemies to have -20% to physical damage reduction.
* Now causes cursed enemies to take 50% increased damage while on Low Life at gem level 1, up to 88% increased damage at gem level 20.
* Now causes cursed enemies you hit to be Debilitated for 2 seconds.
* Now causes 10% of Overkill damage from killing blows against cursed enemies to be reflected to other enemies as physical damage.
* Now gains 1% increased effect of curse per 2% gem quality (previously caused cursed enemies to grant 1% increased attack speed on melee hit per 4% gem quality).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.6.0|
* Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 16 (was 24).
* Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 33 (was 50).
}}
{{Version history table row|2.6.0|
* Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.0.0|
* Punishment now causes cursed enemies to grant a buff to anyone they hit with melee attacks. The buff grants more Melee Damage and increased Attack Speed. It no longer reflects damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.0.5|
* Punishment has had its base damage reflection increased by a flat 6%. 
* Damage reflection against higher rarity monsters has been also been increased. For example, damage reflection against unique monsters has been increased by a flat 11%. 
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.0e|
* Fixed the gem quality bonuses for the Punishment skill.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.0|
* The Punishment curse has returned after being disabled for a long time.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.5|
* Disabled the Punishment skill gem from being found until we have it working properly.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.2|
Added new skill prototype - "Punishment": Curses all targets in an area, causing them to suffer some of the physical damage they deal with their attacks.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
